description: Return the canonical DPO2U compliance pipeline (DISCOVER → AUDIT → ASSESS → REMEDIATE → DOCUMENT → PROVE → REGISTER, plus on-demand ERASE). Use this before chaining compliance tools so the ordering is derived from the protocol, not guessed from tool names. Optionally filter to a single stage by name.

stage.description: Optional stage name filter (DISCOVER | AUDIT | ASSESS | REMEDIATE | DOCUMENT | PROVE | REGISTER | ERASE). When set, returns only that stage.

name: describe_pipeline
